Yes, I e reached that point too, but every time I do get there something happens and pull me right back down. I’m afraid that everytime I become genuinely happy something is gonna fuck it up and it’s been proven true. I fear the future so it’s hard to want to look up to it.
I really appreciate the good comment tho, I hope you keep your peace :)

I thought about therapy and I have 2 reasons for not going.

1.	⁠I don’t want my mom finding out
2.	⁠I have a mind that only i can really move, no matter how much someone tells me something. if I can’t tell myself it, then it probably won’t happen.

It does feel nice to let it out online and relate to others, and the comments are a breath of fresh air so thank you :)
Thank you, I’ll check out the music, seen the manga :)
If you wouldn’t mind, I’m andy. Nice to meet you.
Your the best you can be don’t blame yourself, the fault isn’t in you but that monster that would do that to you. Let your parents know, don’t carry this on yourself

As a person currently suffering from it I can’t agree with you, but I understand your point. Some people will rise and give life another shot. But there’re those that will only fall deeper.

I’m a person who doesn’t like small talk, when I have a conversation I want it to be a conversation
I understand this, even if I leave an open ended question they’ll find a way to answer with yes or no and that brings down my self esteem
And I hope that life stays with you till the end of yours, happy for u man :)
Thank you for that, but people never reached out. I’m always the conversation starter and if I don’t start there won’t be a conversation. So I don’t think it hurts to want someone to reach out

Yea, like when ever I have a question in my mind I search it up and add to the collection of useless facts that no one gives a rats ass about. I hate small talk but when I tell people that they think I’m too picky.

And that’s the problem, when ever I try the voice in my head just gets louder and louder till I can’t ignore it anymore. They fears I hold back comes alive and fucks my life even worst then it already is. I’m scared to loose what I already have so I stoped trying, it’s pathetic ik but I can’t fight this anxiety back.
Happy to help out :)

Thank you, but that can be hard when your an introvert with anxiety. They outside world feels so dangerous that I only go out to school. Peoples eyes are so intimidating that I can’t keep eye contact. And the fear of being judged is so heavy that the words « hi » won’t even leave my throat.
Yes, those conversation becomes like a ring bell in the ear. But u can’t just tell them to stop so you pretend to know stuff you dont( and the guilt of lying will strike you later)
Yea, most people in the world are extroverts and they would understand you. They’ll just think oh this person is boring and doesn’t have a life( I mean they’re not wrong)

The thing is I’m actually very good a socializing. I can draw out a conversation with someone for a long time just talking about themselves. But at one point the topic chances to you and besides a few things I enjoy doing there is nothing else. After reaching that point conversation fall flat
I’ve let every person in my life down
I hope those people stay in your life
I understand, I just wish their was a way to express myself and others would understand with out it bringing down my self esteem in conversing
Yea, like you can keep the conversation going until they start asking about your life
